svg.text: Build flow — how Vortex RTL becomes a FireSim image
Vortex stays Verilog: Golden Gate never sees inside it. Runs from hw/syn/firesim/Makefile with the native flows' tokens.
Threaded images (FAME-5) are the maxsim flow, compiled by CIRCT: see maxsim.md.
Front end — the configured tree, flattened
make -C hw/syn/firesim [PLATFORM=<xsa> | DEVICE=<part>] TARGET=hw|sim|hw_emu
gen_sources.sh -P preprocesses hw/rtl into one self-contained directory, top VX_firesim_wrap:
vivado_srcs/ + .f ← -DSYNTHESIS -DVIVADO -DNDEBUG (+ -DSIMULATION for TARGET=sim/hw_emu)
vortex_srcs/ (metasim) ← -DNDEBUG only: behavioural RAMs, soft FPU
Platform defines: VX_CFG_PLATFORM_MEMORY_NUM_BANKS=1 · PLATFORM_MEMORY_ID_WIDTH=4
(paired with idBits) · [PERF_ENABLE]
FAME-1: Vortex as a Verilog BlackBox
stage → replace-rtl — Golden Gate on the harness only
VortexTarget.scala elaborates: VortexDUT holds VX_firesim_wrap as an opaque BlackBox;
Golden Gate applies FAME-1 at its boundary, inserts bridges and token channels.
→ FireSim-generated.sv (harness; Vortex NOT inside)
xilinx-ips — vendor floating-point cores
xil_fma, xil_fdiv, … generated for FPGA_PART; the flattened tree only instantiates them.
(On aved the RTU keeps the soft FMA/divider: the clock-enable conversion cannot enter an OOC core.)
Platform build — the card's own flow
vitis: v++ link · aved: slashkit. The kernel is packaged from three inputs:
VORTEX_VIVADO_SRCS = the CIRCT netlist VORTEX_XILINX_IP_DIR = the vendor cores
FireSim-generated.sv = the harness
Vivado synthesis + place-and-route at FREQUENCY (default 60 MHz), STRATEGY=TIMING;
on aved, FireSim's clock gates become clock enables (no BUFGCE in the partition).
Image — build32_<aved|xsa>_<hw|sim|hw_emu>/bin/
firesim.vbin | firesim.xclbin + firesim.card
Metasimulator (no image) — TARGET=xrtsim / avedsim
`elaborate` runs Golden Gate alone; sim/firesim/Makefile Verilates
FireSim-generated.sv + the vortex_srcs tree (library search) into libfiresim.so,
with simif_emul as the host interface — the design itself is the simulator.
EMUL_DEBUG=1 adds --trace +define+DEBUG → +waveformfile=… writes a VCD
Same target, same tokens as the card: the step before silicon.
Run the image: FPGA_BIN_DIR=<bin> ./ci/blackbox.sh --driver=firesim --target=hw --app=…
The Makefile guards the classic failure modes: SYNTHESIS missing from the flattened tree (every RAM
lands in LUTRAM), VX_MEM_PORTS resolving to 0, a changed CONFIGS reusing a stale flatten.
